label: The strong second-mover premise and the regress exclude reciprocal moved movers
meaning: New non-transcription conditional derivation (control 3 of docs/notes/caused-mover-cstar.md, section 4). If a and b move each other and each is being moved, the strong per se premise 1e47e6db makes each a per se link of the other (it needs only that each is moved in some respect), and the regress 226c38f6 excludes the two-cycle. The conclusion is the negation of the reciprocity observation premise 4f6ac439, so {1e47e6db, 226c38f6, 4f6ac439} is inconsistent and at least one must go. On the relevant-respect premise 96da1d33 with the lending reading the bundle is consistent (scratch control 4, not registered). No premise is established.

strong_version_needed.1e47e6db-da06-5a40-9ccf-fbd1f929c596: The proof applies the premise to a, moving b in r while a is moved in s, and to b, moving a in s while b is moved in r. No premise says that either being-moved respect is relevant to the moving. The weak version SecondMoversMoveAsMovedInRelevantRespectReading (96da1d33) requires RelevantTo y x r r'.
